new.s: Which method creates dense, multi-layered mini-forests of native species in urban areas?

new.s: In which areas of Andhra Pradesh were most Forest Rights Act titles distributed?

new.angle: U0781 #8 FRA implementation in AP -> ITDA areas

new.s: About how many community forest rights titles had been distributed in Andhra Pradesh by 2022?

new.angle: U0781 #8 FRA in AP -> community titles (notes gap)

new.angle: U0781 #7 AP Vana Samrakshana Samithis -> FRA titles (notes gap)

new.s: Which greenhouse gas do human activities raise only indirectly, by warming the air?
new.x: Humans do not add much water vapour directly; warmer air holds more water vapour, so warming raises it indirectly.
new.angle: U0782 PYQ y998ffc50dd5 water vapour indirect-increase angle

new.s: Why do flooded low-land paddy fields release methane?
o: Rice plants absorb carbon dioxide at night
Standing water evaporates quickly in summer
Organic matter decays without oxygen (anaerobic conditions)
Nitrogen fertilisers break down in sunlight
new.x: In flooded paddies, organic matter decomposes under no-oxygen (anaerobic) conditions, producing methane.
new.angle: U0782 PYQ y086075d354a / yf9579ff7049 low-land rice -> methane angle

new.s: Which of the following is the main reason for the melting of glaciers around the world?

new.s: According to the WMO, about what share of radiative forcing by long-lived greenhouse gases is due to carbon dioxide?

new.s: What was the approximate pre-industrial concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
